# TinyDash theme assets

These are the selected light-theme assets extracted from the `tinydash-master.zip` archive already present at the repository root.

- The public admin interface uses the TinyDash light Bootstrap stylesheet and Feather icon font.
- TESR-U-specific layout, component styling and responsive behaviour live in `admin/assets/css/admin.css`.
- The dashboard content and interactions remain in `admin/assets/js/admin.js`.

The archive did not contain a separate TinyDash licence/readme file. Retain and follow the licence or purchase terms associated with the original archive before distributing or reusing these assets in another project. The bundled Bootstrap stylesheet retains its own MIT licence notice.
